description: Move the user's own money into or out of an earnings vault: DEPOSIT from a currency account into Earnings (MORPHO) or Smart Earnings (YO), WITHDRAW back out. Not for sending money (use initiate_payment), converting currencies (use initiate_currency_exchange) or trading (use initiate_crypto_trade). YO has USD and EUR vaults; MORPHO has USD, EUR and MXN. Check balances with get_balance and rates with get_apy_rates first. Creates a request the user approves and signs in the Moneda mobile app. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

currency.description: Currency of the account and vault

direction.description: DEPOSIT into the vault, or WITHDRAW back to the account

reference.description: Optional note shown on the approval

name: initiate_earnings_move
